messages.subject: Calculate ROC curve
parts:
Is any way to calculate ROC curve for a given model when using the developed code?

I see that here is a modified version of the ENMeval (https://github.com/HemingNM/ENMeval/tree/NMH) but i couldn't find any more detail on that

D.

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: Calculate ROC curve
parts:
Hi Dimitris,

You can get the ROC curve using the dismo::evaluate() and the plot that object. More info at the end of this page (https://rdrr.io/cran/dismo/man/maxent.html)

ev <- evaluate(e@models$L_1, p = occs, a = bg, x = envs)
plot(ev, "ROC")

About the link that you sent, keep in mind that they are using partial ROC, and no the ROC curve. If you are interested to know more about that metric, this paper could be useful: Peterson, A. Townsend, Monica Papeş, and Jorge Soberón. "Rethinking receiver operating characteristic analysis applications in ecological niche modeling." Ecological modelling 213.1 (2008): 63-72.

Best,
Gonzalo
